name: Brand Growth
headline: Put your AI agent on the growth team.
description: A curated path through the Goose Skills catalog for consumer and ecommerce brands to research the market, analyze opportunities and performance, create on-brand work, and improve the next iteration.

routes.$comment: Routing is NOT declared here. It is derived from skills/entry/gooseworks/routes.json by scripts/build-router.js; test/brand-growth-routes.test.js guards the drift.

stages.name: Research
stages.description: Understand the brand, customers, competitors, audiences, creators, trends, comments, and product demand.

stages.name: Analyze
stages.description: Diagnose ads, creator profiles, transcripts, policy risk, landing-page alignment, and performance gaps.

stages.name: Create
stages.description: Turn the evidence into ads, product photography, graphics, social content, and motion creative.

example_prompts: Analyze the ads my three competitors are currently running.
Mine these TikTok and Instagram comments for objections and buying intent.
Find skincare creators whose audiences match women aged 25–40 in the US.
Diagnose our Meta performance and recommend the next creative test.
Research demand for this new product idea.
